Explicit remote requires a complete private SX subtitle issuer and returns a fixed /nimbus-play/v1/sxapi-subtitle address and separate header ticket. expires_at is the actual committed admission deadline before activation and the unchanged actual hard deadline after activation; it is not a renewed TTL.

id.description: Stable version/source identity for this bound file record; use as version_id in playback operations. The session additionally binds the current internal source path and content revision.

streamTicketHeader.name: X-SXAPI-Stream-Ticket
streamTicketHeader.description: Exactly one independently scoped stream credential. At most4096 bytes; duplicate/combined/query credentials are rejected. Other protocol credentials are rejected; Authorization does not participate.

subtitleTicket.name: X-SXAPI-Subtitle-Ticket
subtitleTicket.description: Random shared-Redis deployment-realm ticket; must be combined with its original SXAPI Bearer. Not a JWT or stream ticket.
